review.notes: Checked all 303 targets of the 45 batch layers. The reviewer read the 66 present targets at source, with their variable lines and hypotheses. The 48 partial and 189 absent targets were re-searched by concept, name and synonym in six independent sweeps (one per roadmap, two for ProfiniteCohomology) over declarations.tsv and both source trees. The reviewer re-opened every hit used in a correction. Mechanically, all 45 batch layers are present. Every citation (522 distinct before, 588 after) resolves at its file and line, with its namespace checked against the source; ModularForm.L is missing from the index but is correct at LFunction.lean:134. None is private or deprecated, and no cited file contains sorry. The audit's picture holds. Tau Ceti has built most of ProfiniteCohomology's low-degree explicit theory. The stable-category, periodic, curved, automorphic-congruence, automorphic p-adic L-function and Coleman-integration mathematics is absent from both libraries. Corrections: (1) Both 'built' verdicts fall to 'partly built'. In ProfiniteCohomology Layer 0, neither library equips G-stable subgroups and quotients of discrete modules with their induced actions (target both → partial). In Layer 2, the worked examples H¹(ℤ_p, ℤ/pᵏ) ≅ ℤ/pᵏ and H¹(ℤ_p, ℤ) = 0, which its API paragraph and README §6 assign to it, are absent (target added as partial). (2) 13 target labels.
